description: This PHP source file appears to be part of the TestLink open source test management project. It handles functionality related to assigning test cases to testers, managing test execution assignments, sending email notifications, and rendering views for test case execution and assignment management within the web application.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class managing hierarchical tree structures for test cases or related entities.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class managing test plans, including retrieving plan details and related features.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class representing individual test cases with methods for retrieving and managing test case data.

classes.name: assignment_mgr
classes.description: A class managing test case assignments, including assigning, deleting, and retrieving assignment data.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class managing platform entities linked to test plans.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test projects within the system.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class managing user data and permissions.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty templating engine for rendering views.

methods.name: send_mail_to_testers
methods.description: Builds and sends email notifications to testers about test case assignment changes.

methods.name: doRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all selected test case assignments, optionally sending notifications.

methods.name: doBulkUserRemove
methods.description: Removes specific users from test case assignments in bulk.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing assignment management functions.
